items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Breaking into New York, well Roy Eldridge was the other guy besides who I mentioned already that really embraced Scott and us.

ctx.x: Thank you. Breaking into New York, well Roy Eldridge was the other guy besides who I mentioned already that really embraced Scott and us. Because by then we were a sort of band and worked together. We worked at Jilly’s, for Jilly Rizzo, you know Frank’s friend.
